definition: Changed lines = additions + deletions in each exact PR merge-base-to-head diff (rename detection enabled), not net. Production excludes documentation, audit proof artifacts, tests and verified test-only fixtures; includes runtime/build configuration, build/CI tooling, dependency source/generated patches, and lockfiles. Generated patch text counts are direct Git line changes, not de-minified runtime statements. The desktop xterm bundle patch marked -diff in .gitattributes is counted with --no-index --text between exact exported blobs; that override is recorded per path.
repositoryClassifier: .github/scripts/pr-test-loc-table.mjs:isTestPath is reused. Its displayed Prod is every non-test path, including docs and fixture support; preserve that separately rather than mislabeling audit docs as application LoC.
eligibilityBoundary: Size only. Does not establish risk, user-facing tradeoffs, dependency readiness, CI or merge authorization. Binary production changes are ineligible for automatic under-100 classification.

validation.fixtureReview: Every excluded supplemental fixture under src has only test or other test-fixture named consumers at its exact published head. Documentation fixtures remain excluded regardless of helper naming.
